issues.description: Method name mismatch for Farm's public song method: the problem statement instructs to implement public void singFarmSong() (problem_statement.md) and the template Farm.java declares public void singFarmSong() (template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 9), and the provided template Main.java calls farm.singFarmSong() (template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java line 35). The solution implementation instead exposes a public method named playFarmSong() (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 59). This naming divergence changes the public API that students are expected to implement/use, will break calls to singFarmSong() in the template Main/tests, and will confuse students about which method to provide.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the public API name across all artifacts. Rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() method in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong(). Ensure the problem statement, template Main, and solution consistently reference the same method name so students and tests use the identical API.
